item.title: Beans on the Windowsill
item.summary: A simple diary follows two cups of beans over several days.
item.content_markdown:
**Monday.** I put a bean in Cup A and a bean in Cup B. Both cups have wet paper inside. They are on the windowsill. I put a little water in Cup A. My brother Ben puts the same amount of water in Cup B.

**Thursday.** I can see a small green leaf in Cup A. Ben cannot see a leaf in Cup B. We look at the cups after breakfast. We leave both cups in the same place.

**Sunday.** There is a leaf in Cup B now. Ben takes a photo of the two cups. He wants to send it to our aunt. She gave us the beans when she came to our house last week.

questions.prompt: What is this diary mainly about?
options: How an aunt grows food outside
How two children watch their beans grow
questions.explanation: The entries follow the two beans from Monday to Sunday.
The Monday entry says both cups are on the windowsill.

questions.prompt: When does the writer first see a leaf in Cup A?
questions.explanation: The Thursday entry is the first one to mention a leaf in Cup A.

questions.prompt: Why might their aunt like the photo?
options: She asked them to plant a tree.
She took the photo at her house.
She gave the children the beans.
She bought the cups that morning.
questions.explanation: The aunt gave them the beans, so the photo can show her what has grown.

questions.prompt: The writer and Ben move the cups to a new place on Thursday.
questions.explanation: They leave both cups in the same place.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentences with words from the passage.
questions.text: After seeing a leaf in Cup B, Ben takes a ___.
questions.explanation: The Sunday entry says Ben takes a photo of the two cups.
